assertions.assert: Each element (hears_name, sorted_identities) takes exactly its declared attributes, the required ones present and none empty, and no content, and the namespace has no other element: a malformed element raises error.execution and assigns nothing (its schema, package/identity.xsd, rejects it before any run under scx validate).

<identity:hears_name> writes true exactly when the name's case-folded letter-and-digit tokens appear as a whole run among the text's; a missing name or one with no tokens is never heard, and a text that is neither a string nor null raises error.execution and assigns nothing.

<identity:sorted_identities> writes the identities in the original's order: names first by their text in code point order, then embeddings by their compact Python JSON, stable and with repeats kept; ids that are not an array of identities raise error.execution and assign nothing.
